answer: A new key starts with zero weight. To earn influence it must tend a public orchard of completed jobs, each signed by a different paying counterparty over many weeks. Spinning fresh labels is cheap, but growing that harvest is not — a farm of clones has no fruit. Collateral sits in a basalt vault that slashes every key sharing a funder, host, or lock-step clock as one tree. Vesting also demands a velvet texture in the log: irregular partners and pauses no batch script can stamp onto a thousand identities at once.
